policies.rule: UpstreamDrift owns statistical semantics; Tools consumes a versioned contract and does not create a competing authority.
ShotLink-derived rows remain internal and are excluded from vendor-surrogate training and public row-level outputs until separately approved.
Release A qualifies the software against existing evidence; Release B requires controlled same-shot paired-device validation.
Player analysis requires an explicitly selected trustworthy identity and never infers identity from session, club, source, filename, or row order.
